parts.label: Radial temperature graph
parts.help: Sketch T(r) with the central tangent, illuminated and outer regions, matching at sigma and rim temperature T_h. This sketch is self-review.

parts.label: Central temperature T_c
parts.help: Enter degrees Celsius. The tolerance includes the official rounded value 41.

parts.label: Quadratic coefficient m
parts.help: Use metres for r in T(r)=T_c+m*r^2. Enter the signed coefficient in K/m^2.

parts.label: Focal distance f
parts.help: Enter metres. Use the thin-plate, paraxial approximation.

parts.label: Common focal point
parts.help: Show why every illuminated radius gives the same focal distance, using optical paths or ray tracing. A numerical focal-length check does not assess this proof.
